description: Autopilot tool-result round trip, two streamed calls. Turn 1 must stream calls to lookup_order / lookup_customer carrying the order and customer ids drawn for this run; turn 2 sends those calls back with their results and must stream an answer that quotes the codes only the results hold.

parts.text: You are the tool-calling test harness of an AI agent platform. Follow the user's instructions exactly.

Look up order {{order_id}} and customer {{customer_id}}. Call lookup_order and lookup_customer in parallel, both in this same turn, and wait for their results. When you have the results, reply in one short sentence that quotes the status_code and the tier_code exactly as returned, and do not call any tool again.

function_declarations.name: lookup_order
function_declarations.description: Returns the status code of an order.

order_id.description: The order id, exactly as the user wrote it.

function_declarations.name: lookup_customer
function_declarations.description: Returns the account tier code of a customer.

customer_id.description: The customer id, exactly as the user wrote it.
